description: BigO Lens Validation Corpus catalog for accuracy and coverage benchmarking (BL-601)

cases.name: Prefix Sums
cases.rationale: Single increasing unit-step loop computing prefix sums in linear time.

cases.name: Two-Pointer Target Sum
cases.rationale: Converging while loop where each path increments left or decrements right.

cases.name: Sliding Window
cases.rationale: Sequential linear passes over fixed-size subarray windows.

cases.name: Matrix Multiplication
cases.rationale: Three-level nested for-loop over matrix dimensions n, k, and m.

cases.name: Grid Traversal
cases.rationale: Standard 2D grid nested loops over rows and columns.

cases.name: Selection Sort
cases.rationale: Dependent inner loop for j in (i+1, n), evaluated exactly via triangular summation.

cases.name: Bubble Sort
cases.rationale: Two nested loops both bounded by n, yielding quadratic complexity.

cases.name: Iterative Binary Search
cases.rationale: Iterative binary search updates indices based on array values; reported as Unknown without guessing.

cases.name: Recursive Binary Search
cases.rationale: Recurrence T(n) = T(n/2) + O(1) resolved via Master Theorem Case 2.

cases.name: Merge Sort
cases.rationale: Recurrence T(n) = 2T(n/2) + O(n) resolved via Master Theorem Case 2.

cases.name: Binary Exponentiation
cases.rationale: Halving while-loop with exp /= 2 producing logarithmic trip count.

cases.name: Sieve of Eratosthenes
cases.rationale: Initial sieve linear loop is proven; inner composite marking has dynamic stride.

cases.name: Standard Sort Algorithm
cases.rationale: STL algorithm cost model applies O(N log N) for std::sort on vector.

cases.name: Set Insertion Loop
cases.rationale: STL cost model adds O(log N) per insert operation inside a linear loop.

cases.name: 2D Vector Grid DP
cases.rationale: Nested DP loops with sized 2D vector allocation.

cases.name: Collatz Conjecture Loop
cases.rationale: 3n+1 sequence with data-dependent termination, truthfully reported as Unknown.

cases.name: Naive Fibonacci
cases.rationale: Multiple subtractive recursion T(n) = T(n-1) + T(n-2) + O(1), explicitly Unsupported.

cases.name: Sum Constrained Multitest
cases.rationale: Test-case loop with sum constraints packed to yield proven superadditive bound.

cases.name: Counting Sort
cases.rationale: Sequential linear passes over key range and input size.

cases.name: Euclidean GCD Algorithm
cases.rationale: Euclidean remainder loop without fixed bounds reported as Unknown.
